name: Taiwan
about: Oct–Nov is the clearest, most comfortable stretch; typhoon season runs Jul–Sep, and Dec–Feb brings persistent grey, drizzly weather to the north.
overview: Night markets, hot springs, and a genuinely efficient MRT system, anchored by the once-tallest building on Earth.
costOverview: Street food, bubble tea, and transit all cost next to nothing — Taipei 101's observation deck is the one real splurge ticket.

specialSeasons.text: Typhoon season — mountain roads and trails like Taroko Gorge can close on short notice for landslide risk.
Lunar New Year and the Lantern Festival bring major celebrations, though many small businesses also close for several days around the New Year itself.

monthlyWeather: cool, grey and often drizzly, especially in Taipei and the north
